title: 3.3.9a Lab — Array of 3 instances
description: Push three Planet instances at different x positions into a planets array.

steps.title: Push three planets into the array
steps.instructions: In setup(), call `planets.push(new Planet(...))` three times with different x positions (e.g. -3, 0, 3). Give each a different color after pushing.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer on the right and review the arrays-of-instances reading.

requirements.title: First planet pushed to array
requirements.description: Call planets.push(new Planet(...)) at least once.

requirements.title: At least three push calls
requirements.description: planets.push(new Planet(...)) must appear at least three times.
